## Description

Please describe the changes proposed in this Pull Request.

---

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation improvement
- [ ] `perf`: Performance enhancement
- [ ] `test`: Test suite expansion
- [ ] `refactor`: Refactoring without functional changes
- [ ] `chore`: Build or repository maintenance

---

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] **DCO 1.1 Sign-Off**: Commit messages include `Signed-off-by: Your Name <email>`.
- [ ] **Conventional Commits**: PR title adheres to the Conventional Commits specification.
- [ ] **Zero-Dependency Core**: No unnecessary runtime or test dependencies added.
- [ ] **Automated Tests**: Passed locally via `npm test` (`node --test tests/*.test.js`).
- [ ] **Sanitization**: All path and metadata operations are free from injection vectors.
- [ ] **Performance Verification**: Validated concurrent download efficiency.
